title: Analista Manutenção SR (Preditiva)
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Manutenção SR (Preditiva) para atuar no nosso time de Manutenção Industrial - Confiabilidade.

Quais as responsabilidades?

Realizar análises preditivas de equipamentos rotativos;

Elaborar recomendações técnicas com base nos diagnósticos realizados;

Ser responsável pelos planos de análises de preditivas durante a safra e planos de hibernação e conservação durante a e-safra.

Quais os requisitos?

Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas afins;

Conhecimento avançado em processos de Manutenção Preditiva de equipamentos Rotativos – análise de vibração, balanceamento estático e dinâmico, alinhamento de máquinas, análise de óleo e termografia mecânica;

Familiaridade com o coletor e o sistema AMS Emerson;

Domínio em SAP - módulo PM;

Residir em São José do Rio Preto, Olímpia, Severínia ou Cajobi/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Técnico(a) de Manutenção Mecânica Sr
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Acompanhar e executar atividades de manutenção mecânica em paradas programadas/corretivas e orientar e acompanhar os serviços de manutenção das empresas prestadoras de serviços;
  • Anotar os reparos feitos em ordens de serviços e peças trocadas, para manutenção e emitir ordens de serviço para execução das mesmas;
  • Inspecionar novos materiais mecânicos para serem adicionados em estoque;
  • Participar do planejamento de programação de manutenção corretiva planejada, preventiva e preditiva, visando minimizar o tempo não produtivo dos equipamentos;
  • Preencher/executar as ordens de manutenção planejadas no SAP-PM corretamente, registrando informações pertinentes, como: dados de intervenção, especialidades envolvidas, HH, tempos e custos de manutenção, soluções aplicadas, recomendações futuras e observações importantes;
  • Acompanhar as manutenções emergenciais, programando sua imediata execução;
  • Realizar análise de falhas conforme os critérios padrões e se comprometer com os planos de ações bem como o bloqueio das falhas.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Técnico Completo em Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;
  • Experiência com manutenção em ambiente industrial;
  • Desejável ensino superior cursando;
  • Desejável experiência na área de Madeiras ou Papel/Celulose;
  • Residir na região de Montenegro/RS.

FlexPro Meals provides chef-prepared healthy meals, delivered quickly and nationwide.   • Previous experience in account management, sales or customer retention is preferred
  • A proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a customer-focused mindset

title: Supervisor(a) Cultivo
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Cultivo para atuar no nosso time de Tratos Culturais.

Quais as responsabilidades?

Supervisionar as atividades de cultivo e adubação da cana-de-açúcar;

Gerir metas de custo e eficiência estipuladas;

Acompanhar produtividade da área;

Liderar time operacional.

Quais os requisitos?

Superior completo;

Conhecimento em atividades de cultivo e adubação da cana-de-açúcar;

Experiência na gestão de pessoas;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Baguaçu ou Cajobi/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Quality and Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
About the job

Sol-Millennium is hiring for the position of Quality and Regulatory Affairs Specialist!

Position Summary:

The Quality and Regulatory Affairs (QARA) Specialist will serve as the Responsible Pharmacist. Must be able to provide an active pharmacy license with the Regional Council. The Quality and Regulatory Affairs (QARA) Specialist will serve as the Responsible Pharmacist and play a key role in ensuring the company's compliance with applicable Brazilian regulations and international quality Standards. This position leads complaint handling processes; implements corrective and preventive action plans, ensuring quality throughout the entire product lifecycle; reviews respective documents in the Quality Management System, and attends internal and external audits. This position also supports product launches (ANVISA & INMETRO); provides guidance on regulatory submissions; reviews marketing materials according to the respective regulations; and maintains operational licenses and certifications.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, experienced, and proactive professional with at least 3 years of practical experience and quality responsibilities, supporting compliance initiatives, and supporting regulatory intelligence within the medical device industry. Proven experience in managing cross-functional activities, preparing quality and regulatory files, and supporting product lifecycle from development through post-market activities are essential. Strong communication and collaboration skills, along with a sense of responsibility and commitment within a multidisciplinary team, are highly valued.

Main Activities and Responsibilities:

Act as the company’s Responsible Pharmacist, maintaining an active license with the respective Regional Council, and:

  • Oversee product quality control testing to ensure compliance with specifications and regulatory requirements prior to release.
  • Administer the technical complaints process, including case investigation, documentation, root cause analysis, and development of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Actively participate in and support internal and external audits conducted by ANVISA, Inmetro, or notified bodies.
  • Monitor changes in local and international regulations, ensuring timely updates to internal procedures and documentation.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams including R&D, Quality Control, Production, and Marketing to ensure regulatory and quality alignment in all processes.
  • Ensure precise document control and proper retention of technical and regulatory records.
  • Support the launch of new products requiring registration or certification with ANVISA and INMETRO.
  • Prepare, review, and manage regulatory submissions, including product registrations, renewals, changes, and certifications.
  • Maintain Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) certifications, operational licenses, and other mandatory regulatory approvals.
  • Promote and lead a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and compliance within the organization.

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy discipline required.
  • Active license with the respective Brazilian Regional Council (required).
  • Strong knowledge of ANVISA and INMETRO regulatory requirements, including product registration, certification, and licensing processes.
  • Experience managing technical complaints, CAPA systems, and quality/regulatory audits.
  • Familiarity with ISO 13485, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and Brazilian RDC Standards.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Working Conditions:

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
  • Tools provided: Laptop and cell phone.
  • Location: Ribeirão Preto/SP.

Salary and Benefits

  • Salary: Competitive with market rates.
  • Bonus: Eligible for the company’s Bonus Program.
  • Benefits: Health/dental plan (Bradesco TP4), Meal allowance (Ticket Flex), life insurance, and access to Totalpass.

About Sol-Millennium

The Sol-Millennium Group is dedicated to building a healthier and safer tomorrow to help people live in a better world. We offer innovative products through the development and distribution of safe medical devices.

If you’re interested in this position and meet the requirements above, don’t wait — apply now and take part in our selection process!

title: Technical Support Analyst - Sao Paulo, Brazil
description:
About Phi Partners

Phi Partners is a global Capital Markets IT consultancy providing technology & quant expertise to some of the world’s largest investment banks, hedge funds, and asset managers. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in London, Phi has a presence globally across North America, EMEA and APAC. Our niche focus on Front Office Technology and Quantitative services has been a differentiator and gateway into the world’s best financial institutions. Our client is a leading Asia-based investment bank and long-term strategic partner of Phi Partners, with a global presence and over $1 trillion in assets under management.

About the Client Programme

Phi Partners has supported this Investment Banking client for over a decade across Front Office Quant, eTrading, Pricing & Risk, and Core Technology. Since 2017, our Global Risk Technology collaboration has expanded from a small specialist team into a global capability supporting their enterprise risk platforms. As part of our long-term strategic initiative, we are investing in building a young, dynamic, and high-performing talent hub in Brazil - strengthening the future-facing foundation of our partnership and supporting the bank’s global technology strategy. With the Global Risk remit continuing to grow across international branches, we are now scaling the team further and hiring a Lead Technical Support Analyst to support their US Global Risk function.

Roles and Responsibilities

As a Lead Technical Support Analyst, you will ensure the stability, accuracy, and performance of the Global Risk Platform (GRP) used across the bank. You’ll act as a key link between Risk, Front Office, and Technology teams, providing high-quality support and driving continuous improvements for the NY office, as the lead for your team of about 3-4 people under you. Your responsibilities include:

• Validation of exposures in a trade by comparing previous day trade exposure within the database • Responding to support incidents and end-user service requests

• Communicating issues to stakeholders promptly in line with ITIL processes

• Producing local and global risk measures as well as reports

• Responsible for release management on GRP UAT and Production environments

• Coordinating test environment set-up

• Helping BA/DEVs with Stress testing

• Performing end-to-end test runs in all environments as required

• Contributing to operational documentation (e.g., knowledge-library articles, runbooks, etc.)

• Managing the infrastructure changes needed to enable access to the platform for all user globally

Key Skills

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience leading Global Risk Platform teams in Investment Banking, with technical support experience and an understanding of functional risk concepts.

Necessary

• Confident ownership in resolving production issues utilising technical and functional expertise

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management with clients and team members

• Expertise in risk concepts within investment banking (Market, Credit, Regulatory Risk)

• Proven L2 production support leadership experience for business-critical, front-to-back risk systems

• Ability to perform deep root cause analysis across application issues and drive resolution end-to-end

• Strong SQL and data analysis skills for investigating, reporting, and reconciliation issues

Desirable

• Experience in Cloud Technologies

• ITIL certification or proven experience

Next steps

This is a strong opportunity for a Lead Technical Support Analyst who thrives in fast-paced, business-critical environments and wants to play a key role in the stability and evolution of a global Market Risk platform. You’ll join a rapidly growing Capital Markets IT consultancy and contribute directly to a long-term strategic initiative with one of our longstanding investment banking partners. If you're interested, please send your updated CV at We’d be happy to arrange a call to discuss the opportunity in more detail at your earliest convenience.

title: Clinical Applications Specialist
description:
Job Title: Clinical Applications Specialist – Ultrasound (Independent Contractor)

Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred or remote with travel)

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor / Consultant Agreement (Full-time dedication required)

Company: CHISON Medical Imaging

Position Overview

We are seeking a Clinical Applications Specialist – Ultrasound to partner with CHISON as an independent contractor on a full-time consultancy basis . You will serve as the local clinical expert supporting our ultrasound business in Brazil, providing clinical and technical expertise during the sales cycle, delivering product training to customers, and building relationships with clinical users. This role requires hands-on clinical experience with ultrasound systems and full professional proficiency in Portuguese and English .

You will operate under a consultant service agreement (not an employment contract). The role requires full-time dedication during the contract term. You retain the flexibility to manage your own work schedule.

Core Responsibilities

  • Provide ultrasound-specific clinical and technical expertise during the sales cycle, demonstrating CHISON ultrasound systems to potential customers.
  • Develop and deliver product training and clinical education on ultrasound equipment operation, image optimization, and clinical applications to local sales teams and end users.
  • Create and validate clinical content (e.g., case studies, application notes) showcasing CHISON ultrasound solutions (General Imaging, Vascular, OB/GYN).
  • Support marketing activities (webinars, seminars, trade shows) by performing ultrasound product demonstrations.
  • Build and maintain relationships with local clinical users and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in the ultrasound community.
  • Monitor customer installations and provide post-sale clinical support to ensure high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with global sales team to relay market feedback.

Skills & Qualifications

Mandatory Requirements:

  • Clinical Ultrasound Experience: Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience performing diagnostic ultrasound examinations in a clinical setting. Proficiency in General Imaging/Abdominal and Vascular sonography is required.
  • ARDMS or equivalent sonography registry/certification is strongly preferred.
  • Language & Location:
  • Full professional proficiency in Portuguese (written and spoken) – mandatory.
  • Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) – mandatory.
  • Must be based in Brazil and legally authorized to work as an independent contractor.
  • Availability: Full-time dedication to the project during the contract term (approximately 40 hours per week). You determine your own daily schedule.

Preferred Skills:

  • Previous experience as a Clinical Applications Specialist , Ultrasound Technologist , or in a clinical support role within an ultrasound manufacturer.
  • Additional clinical knowledge in Cardiac or OB/GYN ultrasound.
  • Willingness to travel domestically within Brazil.

Engagement Terms (Consultant Agreement)

  • Contract type: Independent contractor / service provider agreement (not an employment contract).
  • Working arrangement: Full-time dedication to CHISON during the contract term. You manage your own work schedule and are not required to follow fixed office hours.
  • Compensation: Monthly service fee to be agreed (paid upon invoice submission).
  • Tax & benefits: You are responsible for your own taxes, social security, health insurance, and any statutory benefits.
  • Expenses: Travel and customer-related expenses reimbursed according to company policy.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to serve as the local clinical expert for a global ultrasound company.
  • Collaborative and international work environment.
  • Competitive monthly service fee (to be discussed).
  • Flexible scheduling – you control your own working hours.

title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Senior .NET Developer | Electronic Trading (CLT or PJ)

Let’s be clear from the start.

This role iS NOT about CRUD APIs, comfort zones, or hiding behind frameworks.

This is about building high throughput, low latency trading systems where every decision around threads, memory, and execution flow has real impact on money, markets, and performance.

You will join a greenfield initiative to build an electronic trading platform for Fixed Income products, used by a global trading business operating under constant pressure. The project has long term sponsorship, real technical ownership, and zero tolerance for weak engineering.

The platform is built from scratch with modern .NET and cloud native architecture, and the work goes deep into runtime behavior, concurrency, and resource management. If you enjoy understanding what happens under the hood, this is where you belong.

If you are looking for something safe, slow, or average, this is not for you.

What You Will Work On

You will spend your time building and optimizing backend services where advanced .NET concepts are used daily, not talked about theoretically.

This includes real production work with:

• Multithreading and thread synchronization

• Async and await internals and execution flow

• Garbage Collection behavior and memory allocation patterns

• Resource lifecycle management using IDisposable and manual disposal

• Concurrency control and race condition prevention

• Lock, Monitor, Mutex, and cross thread or cross process synchronization

• Designing services for high throughput and low latency workloads

• Applying threading and async patterns in market driven, time critical scenarios

You will work side by side with senior engineers and architects across multiple regions, influencing architecture, code quality, and technical standards.

Who We Want to Talk To

You are already senior. You have seen complex systems in production and you understand what breaks under load.

We are looking for people with:

• Strong hands on experience with .NET in backend systems

• Deep, practical experience with multithreading and asynchronous programming

• Solid understanding of the .NET runtime, memory management, and resource handling

• Experience building performance sensitive or low latency platforms

• Strong ASP.NET Core and API design experience

• Comfort working with large, long lived systems where mistakes are costly

• Experience with testing, CI/CD, and production grade engineering practices

If your experience stops at surface level abstractions, this will not be a fit.

Nice to Have

• Electronic trading or financial systems experience

• Fixed Income market knowledge

• AWS experience

• Proven track record improving performance, scalability, or system stability

title: Sr Financial Analyst
description:
WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

THE JOB

The Senior Finance Analyst plays a key role in consolidating and harmonizing financial and accounting practices across multiple subsidiaries. This position supports the accuracy and integrity of accounting records, ensures compliance with corporate policies, and drives alignment with financial best practices. Partnering closely with subsidiary accounting teams, the Senior Finance Analyst provides guidance, implements standardized processes, and delivers reliable financial insights to support holding-level operations and strategic decision-making.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Manage and oversee accounting processes while supporting subsidiaries, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, accruals, and month-end close activities.
  • Support the consolidation of financial statements and management reporting, improving accuracy, consistency, and transparency across all entities.
  • Act as a liaison between Holding company and subsidiary accounting teams, promoting best practices and ensuring adherence to corporate accounting standards and policies.
  • Monitor holding-level cash flow and working capital, ensuring timely, accurate, and complete financial data from subsidiaries.
  • Identify and recommend opportunities to enhance accounting efficiency and accuracy through process standardization, automation, and system improvements.
  • Provide reliable financial and accounting data to Holding leadership to support operational planning, analysis, and strategic decision-making.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related field.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in accounting, audit, or corporate finance, preferably within multi-entity, regional, or holding company structures.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles (IFRS/US GAAP), reconciliations, consolidations, and financial reporting.
  • Hands-on experience managing AP/AR processes, month-end close preparation across multiple entities.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluency in English

HIRING PRACTICES

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote

About SignalPET

SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.

Role Overview

We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.

Qualifications

  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.

*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***

This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.

Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.

We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

description:
Senior Manager Of Fund Operations & Client Services

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil | On site: Rua Helena 260, Vila Olímpia.

We are looking for a senior leader to join our Fund Services business, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commercial mindset to drive both service excellence and revenue growth.

This is a high-impact role where you will lead fund operations, manage key client relationships, and play a critical role in expanding our presence within the investment funds space.

The Opportunity

You will be responsible for overseeing the end-to-end management of fund administration services while actively contributing to the growth of the business. This includes working closely with clients, leading a team, and identifying new business opportunities across private equity, real estate, and alternative investment structures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a senior technical and commercial point of contact for clients, stakeholders, and internal teams
  • Manage a portfolio of fund administration clients, ensuring high-quality service delivery
  • Lead fund structuring, onboarding, and lifecycle management, including launches and transitions
  • Drive business development initiatives, identify opportunities, and close new mandates
  • Oversee NAV review processes and ensure accuracy in financial reporting
  • Collaborate with global teams to deliver seamless fund accounting and investor services
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks and support audits and reporting requirements
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing fund services team

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience within the investment funds industry
  • Candidates must hold both CGA and CGE certifications
  • Strong background in fund administration, fund accounting, or structuring (PE/RE preferred)
  • Proven commercial track record with the ability to originate and close business
  • Established network with fund managers, family offices, and investment advisors
  • Experience managing and developing teams in a professional services environment
  • Strong knowledge of NAV, fund structures, and regulatory frameworks
  • Excellent client-facing and communication skills

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to play a strategic leadership role within a growing global platform
  • High level of client exposure and commercial ownership
  • Collaborative, international environment with strong operational support
  • Ability to shape and grow a business line within your market

If you are a commercially driven fund services professional looking to take on a leadership role with real impact, we would love to hear from you.

title: Geotécnico(a) Pleno
description:
Geotécnico(a) Pleno

Local: Fazenda Brasileiro – Teofilândia (BA), Brasil

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Disponibilidade: Mudança para a região (empresa oferece suporte)

Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Geotécnico Pleno para atuar em operação de mineração a céu aberto (open pit) , com papel estratégico na estabilidade geotécnica e segurança das operações .

Será responsável pelo monitoramento de cavas, taludes e pilhas de estéril , além de acompanhar as atividades de curto prazo, garantindo aderência aos parâmetros geotécnicos.

Procuramos um profissional com experiência em geotecnia aplicada à mineração , conhecimento em mecânica de rochas e atuação em gestão de riscos . Vivência em open pit é essencial, sendo diferencial experiência em mineração subterrânea.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o monitoramento geotécnico de cavas, taludes, pilhas de estéril e estruturas associadas;
  • Analisar a estabilidade de taludes em mina a céu aberto (open pit) e/ou subterrânea;
  • Acompanhar as atividades operacionais de curto prazo, garantindo conformidade com os parâmetros geotécnicos;
  • Interpretar dados de instrumentação geotécnica (piezômetros, inclinômetros, radar, entre outros);
  • Elaborar e revisar relatórios técnicos geotécnicos;
  • Desenvolver e validar modelos geotécnicos e geomecânicos;
  • Propor e acompanhar medidas de mitigação de riscos geotécnicos;
  • Atuar na gestão de riscos, assegurando a segurança das operações de mina;
  • Apoiar no planejamento de lavra, fornecendo recomendações geotécnicas;
  • Participar de investigações geotécnicas (campo e análise de dados);
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e padrões de segurança aplicáveis;
  • Interagir com equipes multidisciplinares (geologia, planejamento, operação).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (preferencialmente de Minas, Geológica ou Civil) ou Geologia;
  • Experiência comprovada em geotecnia aplicada à mineração;
  • Vivência em operações de mina a céu aberto (open pit);
  • Vivência com monitoramento geotécnico, instrumentação e análise de estabilidade de taludes, cavas e pilhas de estéril;
  • Desejável experiência em operações que possuam mina subterrânea e mina a céu aberto simultaneamente e/ou em interação direta (cava sobreposta ou operações integradas);
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para Teofilândia, BA.

title: Monitor Pesquisa Clinica Pleno - PROADI-SUS
description:
Com 70 anos de existência, o Einstein Hospital Israelita ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Além da atuação em setores assistenciais, temos oportunidades na área de Inovação, Tecnologia, Pesquisa, Ensino, entre outras. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!

Sumário

O PROADI-SUS é uma iniciativa do Ministério da Saúde que tem como objetivo fortalecer o Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) por meio de parcerias com hospitais filantrópicos de excelência. A Sociedade Beneficente Israelita Brasileira Albert Einstein participa ativamente do programa há mais de 16 anos, desenvolvendo projetos voltados à qualificação da gestão pública, à capacitação de profissionais e à melhoria da qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos à população.

Em conformidade com a Portaria GM/MS nº 5.801/2024 e reafirmando nosso compromisso com a diversidade, equidade e inclusão, esta vaga é destinada à ampla concorrência, com reserva de oportunidades para os seguintes grupos afirmativos:

Pessoas autodeclaradas negras (pretas ou pardas), conforme critérios do IBGE;

Pessoas autodeclaradas indígenas;

Pessoas autodeclaradas quilombolas;

Pessoas com deficiência (PcD);

Pessoas trans (travestis, mulheres e homens trans).

Os(as) candidatos(as) que optarem por concorrer às vagas reservadas deverão apresentar documentação comprobatória em etapa posterior do processo seletivo, conforme os critérios estabelecidos em edital e combase nas normas vigentes.

O tratamento dessas informações observará os princípios da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais(LGPD), garantindo confidencialidade, segurança e uso exclusivo para fins de verificação de elegibilidade à reserva de vagas.

Diante disso, estamos com uma oportunidade aberta para a posição de

Monitor de Pesquisa Pleno atuará diretamente no Projeto VIGIAMBSI (Vigilância Ambiental e Saúde Indígena), uma iniciativa conduzida em parceria com a Secretaria de Saúde Indígena (SESAI), que visa aprimorar a saúde dos povos indígenas por meio da integração de dados ambientais e de saúde, com foco em saneamento e qualidade ambiental das comunidades selecionadas.

Este profissional será responsável pelo monitoramento da fase de coleta de dados ambientais e amostras(água e solo), pela consolidação, digitalização e controle das informações registadas em campo, bem como pelo apoio à análise espacial e ambiental das localidades atendidas. A função exige sólida compreensão técnico-operacional em saúde ambiental, domínio de ferramentas de geoprocessamento e interesse no desenvolvimento de habilidades analíticas, especialmente na interface entre dados ambientais, geoespaciais e indicadores de saúde coletiva. Atuará de forma articulada com agentes técnicos locais, equipe laboratorial e equipe de análise de dados.

Responsabilidades

Acompanhar a execução técnico-operacional do projeto, com foco no monitoramento da coleta, organização e rastreabilidade de amostras ambientais (água e solo), conforme os protocolos definidos.

Consolidar, revisar e digitalizar os dados de coleta, assegurando a consistência e integridade das informações nas plataformas utilizadas (REDCap, planilhas estruturadas, entre outras).

Apoiar a padronização da georreferenciação dos pontos de coleta, utilizando ferramentas GIS (QGIS,PostGIS), com foco na espacialização e estruturação das informações ambientais e territoriais.

Fornecer suporte à análise exploratória dos dados espaciais e ambientais, colaborando na produção de mapas, dashboards e relatórios técnicos.

Elaborar relatórios técnicos com foco na caracterização ambiental e sanitária das áreas estudadas.

Participar de reuniões técnicas com a equipe do projeto, apoiando a articulação com os Distritos Sanitários Especiais Indígenas (DSEIs) e demais parceiros institucionais.

Requisitos

Graduação em áreas como Saúde Pública, Ciências Ambientais, Gestão Ambiental, Geografia, Biologia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência em projetos voltados à saúde ambiental, saneamento e/ou monitoramento ambiental, preferencialmente em contextos de comunidades tradicionais.

Apoiar a padronização da georreferenciação dos pontos de coleta, utilizando ferramentas GIS (QGIS,PostGIS), com foco na espacialização e estruturação das informações ambientais e territoriais.

Familiaridade com protocolos de coleta de amostras ambientais (água e solo), com atenção à rastreabilidade e controle de qualidade.

Capacidade de atuar na estruturação, integração e modelagem de bases de dados ambientais, incluindo o cruzamento de dados espaciais, laboratoriais e de campo para subsidiar análises estatísticas avançadas.

Disponibilidade para viagens a áreas remotas e interação direta com comunidades indígenas.

title: Analista de Web Designer III
description:

Atuar na otimização e no controle do dimensionamento das equipes da operação, garantindo aderência ao orçamento aprovado e às necessidades projetadas no forecast. Ter atuação estratégica no mapeamento e desdobramento de alavancas de eficiência, apoiando projetos e melhorias de processos com foco em produtividade, sustentabilidade financeira e suporte às decisões do negócio.

Principais atividades:

  • Liderança de projetos de Analytics:
  • Definir e executar a estratégia de coleta de dados para diversas campanhas e iniciativas, atuando em conjunto com times de SEO, Mídia Paga e Sites.
  • Criar apresentações e relatórios para as lideranças, incluindo recomendações estratégicas baseadas em dados.
  • Otimização de conversão (CRO):
  • Arquitetar a camada de dados e o rastreamento da jornada do usuário para funcionalidades digitais estratégicas.
  • Construir dashboards de funil para identificar pontos de atrito e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Governança de ferramentas e qualidade de dados:
  • Gerenciar e garantir a integridade da coleta de dados no portfólio de sites.
  • Implementar processos de melhorias operacionais, qualidade de dados e documentações.
  • Relatórios escaláveis e automação:
  • Arquitetar relatórios de performance utilizando Looker Studio para consolidar dados de forma eficiente em grandes volumes de sites.
  • Parceria estratégica com stakeholders:
  • Colaborar com times de Marketing, SEO, Mídia, Produto, Negócios e Comercial para gerar insights que orientem decisões de negócio.
  • Traduzir análises complexas em narrativas claras e orientadas a ação.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Experiência: Mínimo de 4 anos em Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, CRO ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Ferramentas de Analytics:
  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4) – implementação, governança e análise avançada
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM) – gerenciamento de tags, debug e manutenção
  • Looker Studio (antigo Data Studio) – construção de dashboards
  • Conhecimento em Tecnologias web:
  • JavaScript para customizações e resolução de problemas de coleta de dados
  • Noções de HTML/CSS
  • Conhecimento em SQL para consultas em bancos de dados
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia
  • Organização e gestão de prioridades em ambiente de alta demanda
  • Pacote Office Intermediário-Avançado

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação ou IA aplicada à análise de dados
  • Vivência com projetos de e-commerce
  • Atuação em Metodologias ágeis

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho (Hibrido + 1 vez na semana no presencial, demais dias Home Office)

title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).

Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.

How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Work Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Report To : JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader

Business Type : Cross-border Industrial Supply Chain / MRO Industrial Products Procurement & Sales

I. Business Introduction

JD Industrial is the core business segment of JD Group focusing on industrial supply chain technology and services. We have established a localized operation system in Brazil , focusing on providing end-to-end MRO industrial product supply chain solutions for Chinese-funded overseas enterprises and local large-scale manufacturing/energy/infrastructure enterprises.

  • Core Positioning : Serve customers in Brazil's manufacturing, energy, mining, infrastructure and other industries, providing one-stop procurement, cross-border/local fulfillment, inventory management, supply chain finance and other services for full-category MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations) industrial products.
  • Core Advantages : Relying on JD's global supply chain network, local warehousing, distribution and compliance capabilities in Brazil , and digital procurement platform, we solve the pain points of the Brazilian market such as high prices, long delivery times, scattered suppliers and complex certifications .
  • Business Scope : Covering full MRO categories including tools, labor protection, electrical, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, and spare parts , supporting the dual model of cross-border procurement + local procurement , and realizing fast delivery, compliant customs clearance and credit period settlement in Brazil.

II. Key Job Responsibilities

1. Development and Management of Local MRO Suppliers in Brazil (Core)

  • In-depth development of local MRO suppliers in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.), and establishment of a localized supplier resource pool.
  • Responsible for supplier access, evaluation, negotiation, signing, maintenance and elimination, and building a hierarchical supplier system (head/potential/long-tail).
  • Familiar with the price system, certification requirements (INMETRO), delivery time, credit period and payment habits (OA 90 days, letter of credit installments) of the Brazilian MRO market.

2. MRO Category Procurement and Cost Management

  • Responsible for the full-category MRO procurement in Brazil, undertaking customer needs, and completing the entire process of inquiry, price comparison, negotiation, order placement, fulfillment, reconciliation and settlement.
  • Formulate category procurement strategies, price systems and cost targets, optimize procurement costs, and improve price competitiveness, gross profit and inventory turnover.
  • Analyze the supply and demand, competitors, prices, delivery times and policies of the Brazilian MRO market, and formulate category planning, commodity structure and stock-up strategies.

3. Customer Demand Connection and Solution Output

  • Connect with local Chinese-funded/large-scale enterprise customers in Brazil, explore MRO procurement needs, and provide one-stop procurement solutions, cost optimization, delivery guarantee and inventory management.
  • Coordinate the entire link of cross-border procurement, local procurement, customs clearance, logistics fulfillment and local delivery to ensure timely, compliant and low-cost delivery.
  • Maintain customer relationships, improve repurchase rate, satisfaction and penetration rate, and promote large customer signing, project landing and category expansion.

4. Supply Chain Operation and Data Management

  • Responsible for the entire link operation of MRO inventory, orders, delivery, reconciliation and settlement, ensuring healthy inventory, timely delivery, compliant credit period and fund safety.
  • Track data such as sales, procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time, and output weekly/monthly/analysis reports to support business decisions.
  • Coordinate with JD Industrial's global procurement, cross-border logistics, digital systems, risk control and compliance teams to ensure coordinated, efficient and compliant business operations.

5. Compliance and Risk Management

  • Familiar with Brazilian compliance requirements such as import tariffs, INMETRO certification, commodity inspection, customs declaration, taxation, foreign exchange and labor laws, ensuring that procurement and delivery are legal and compliant.
  • Control supplier risks, price risks, delivery risks, inventory risks, fund risks and compliance risks.

III. Job Requirements

1. Core Competencies (Must-Have)

  • Local MRO Supplier Resources in Brazil : Must have local MRO industrial product supplier resources in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.).
  • MRO Procurement Professional Ability : 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement experience in Brazil/Latin America, familiar with MRO categories, products, prices, certifications, delivery times, credit periods and procurement processes.
  • In-depth Understanding of the Brazilian Market : Familiar with Brazil's industrial market, customer structure, supplier ecology, price system, certification (INMETRO), tariffs, foreign exchange and payment habits.

2. Professional Skills

  • Business Negotiation : Strong ability in price negotiation, negotiation, contract signing and supplier management.
  • Cost and Data Analysis : Price-sensitive, strong cost awareness, proficient in analyzing procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time data.
  • Language Ability : Fluent in Portuguese (native/business level), proficient in English; fluent in Chinese is preferred.
  • Office Tools : Proficient in Excel, PPT, Word and ERP/procurement systems.

3. Comprehensive Quality

  • Business Thinking : Possess the ability of category operation, cost control, profit orientation and inventory management.
  • Customer Orientation : Customer-first, strong service awareness, demand exploration, solution output and customer maintenance.
  • Pressure Resistance and Execution : Result-oriented, strong pressure resistance, strong execution, cross-departmental collaboration and rapid implementation.
  • Compliance and Integrity : Integrity and self-discipline, strong compliance awareness, risk control and high professional quality.

4. Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or above , major in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering is preferred.
  • 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement/sales experience in Brazil/Latin America; experience in local Brazilian supplier resources, Chinese-funded enterprise services and cross-border procurement is preferred.

IV. What We Offer

  • International Platform : JD Industrial's global business, with collaboration between the local Brazilian team and the China headquarters.
  • Salary and Benefits : Highly competitive salary + performance bonus + annual bonus + local Brazilian social security + commercial insurance + paid annual leave + overseas subsidies.
  • Development Space : Promotion paths such as MRO Category Manager, Regional Procurement & Sales Director, and JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader.
  • Localization Support : Local office in Brazil, local team, compliance support, supply chain support and customer resources.

Nossos clientes incluem instituições financeiras, varejistas, órgãos governamentais, casas da moeda, joalherias e outras operações comerciais. Nossa rede de operações em 51 países atende clientes em mais de 100 países.

Acreditamos na construção de parcerias que protegem o comércio, e isso exige fomentar uma cultura engajada que valorize pessoas com diferentes origens, ideias e perspectivas.

Construímos um senso de pertencimento, para que todos os colaboradores se sintam respeitados, seguros e valorizados, e oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades para participação e crescimento.

Como pessoa Supervisora de Importação e Exportação você será responsável por liderar e garantir toda a documentação necessária para os embarques nos processos de importação e exportação, cumprindo prazos e especificações dos órgãos legais e conforme determinação contratual.

Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar diariamente no sistema da Receita Federal a existência de novos pedidos de embarque, acionando as áreas envolvidas e tomando as medidas necessárias;
  • Supervisionar o time quanto à documentação emitida a fim de evitar embarques incorretos;
  • Manter contato permanente com clientes externos e internos (nacional e internacional), avaliando a necessidade de correções de documentos e providenciando-os, a fim de manter os padrões exigidos pela legislação evitando penalidades e multas perante as alfândegas brasileira e do exterior;

  • Supervisionar atividades administrativas como conferências e pagamento de frete aéreo internacional e valores a serem faturados;
  • Conhecer e interpretar os Inconterms (negociações entre importador e exportador) e providenciar instruções de emissão de documentos de acordo com o Incoterm negociado;
  • Seguir procedimentos internos de segurança e sigilo da informação;
  • Manter o cliente devidamente informado de todos os passos/acontecimentos do processo;
  • Participar dos programas de melhoria contínua e disseminar novas propostas de processos junto ao time.

Desafios

  • Garantir que os processos de importação e exportação ocorram de maneira correta e eficaz, providenciando todos os documentos necessários para embarque para exportação e conferência na importação, cumprindo os prazos estabelecidos e evitando penalidades e sanções.

title: Gerente financeiro
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to partner with the Managing Director and the market team to deliver the business plan and support operational execution. This is a managerial role focused on leadership, planning and process improvement, with also some hands-on operational tasks.

Key responsibilities

Financial and operational leadership

• Act as a trusted business partner to the Managing Director and the wider market team to deliver budget and strategy. • Own the annual budget, periodic reforecasts and the monthly forward-looking risks & opportunities view, and drive commercial action plans where required. • Break the business plan and budget into measurable building blocks and KPIs, ensure they are tracked by the FP&A team and by functional partners, and lead corrective actions when performance deviates from target. • Track return on key investments, including capex for new sales initiatives, and provide actionable analysis to improve outcomes. • Provide hands-on operational support to ensure an accurate and timely close, with an initial high level of involvement expected, followed by a substantial reduction as processes are stabilized and effectively managed by the new financial manager.

Finance team leadership

• Build and develop a high-performing finance function aligned to company strategy. • Line-manage and mentor key direct reports (for example Financial Control, treasury, Billing and Cash Collection), ensuring the right people are in the right roles. • Foster collaboration between finance and commercial teams to embed financial discipline across the market.

Process leadership

• Identify and prioritise process improvements across the business (for example debtor management) and drive execution to close the gaps. • Work with the Group finance community to implement best practices and share learnings that other markets can adopt.

Reporting and compliance

• Ensure accurate and timely monthly and annual reporting that meets Group and third-party obligations and that tracks progress against business goals and KPIs. • Plan and oversee the annual audit and tax filings, working with the Group tax and control teams to optimise outcomes. • Support wider reporting requirements such as CSRD and other regulatory or sustainability disclosures as required.

Liquidity and cash management

• Drive delivery against cash targets, ensuring profit is converted into cash. • Assign ownership and targets for each element of working capital, and drive process improvements where necessary. • Maintain a 13-week cash flow forecast and a budgeted liquidity plan. • Coordinate with Group to repatriate cash to the parent company in line with the plan.

Project leadership

• Lead ad-hoc strategic projects, including business cases for commercial opportunities and support for acquisitions or integrations as they arise. • Provide commercial and financial analysis to support decision making and monitor project outcomes.

Desired experience and skills

• Proven finance manager experience in a commercial environment, ideally with exposure to FP&A, financial control and cash management. • Strong analytical skills and experience converting financial insight into commercial action. • Experience leading finance teams and developing talent. • Comfortable working with ERP systems and driving process improvements. • Hands-on month-end close experience and a pragmatic approach to resolving operational issues. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Talent Acquisition Sr Analyst
description:
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

As a member of the talent acquisition team, you'll have the opportunity to work in a cross-regional team with international exposure. We spot, engage and hire the top talents to join DiDi. We drive new growth opportunities for our teams by running talent programs, where our employees can expand their horizons globally.

In this role you will be...

  • Responsible to manage the full end-to-end hiring cycle for roles across multiple teams in the organization.
  • Acting as a strategic partner to business leaders; providing world-class market information, talent intelligence and key practices.
  • Owning the overall candidate experience through the hiring process until onboarding.
  • Using data to make decisions that facilitate hiring and allows the organization to make the best hiring decision.
  • Working with other HR teams to drive efficiencies and process improvements.
  • Working in projects that impact how we shape a culture of recruiting.

We are eager to be in touch with you because you have...

  • 3-4 years of experience in recruiting (preferably in a fast-paced environment such as the internet or consulting companies).
  • Experience using ATS systems (lever, greenhouse, icims, etc).
  • Strong verbal and written communication in English and spanish.
  • Excited about driving change and helping the organization evolve.
  • Knowledgeable about talent acquisition techniques (offer negotiation, sourcing, etc).

You‘ll love working at DiDi because:

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

title: Analista de Gerenciamento de Risco Pleno
description:
A J&T Express é conhecida como uma das maiores empresas do setor de transportes de logística, entrega expressa, armazenamento e cadeia de suprimentos. Estamos presentes em 13 países, como Indonésia, Vietnã, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia, Cambodja, Singapura, China, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes Unidos, México e Brasil. Nossos serviços alcançam mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Todos os dias fornecemos aos nossos clientes uma experiência de entrega expressa de excelente qualidade e eficiência, altamente confiável, trazendo mais benefícios às pessoas e fazendo com que elas aproveitem as transformações da economia digital.

Nossos números: 240 centros de transferências de larga escala;1.000 equipamentos de triagem inteligente;23.000 pontos de distribuição;400.000 colaboradores;

Nossos serviços atingem 2,5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Venha construir um futuro melhor conosco!

Posição: Analista de Gerenciamento de Risco Pleno

Descrição da posição:

Gestão de Riscos: Atuação como facilitador entre transportadoras, gerenciadoras de riscos (GR) e seguradoras para mitigar perdas e otimizar processos logísticos.

Regulação de Sinistros: Análise técnica de processos de roubo e avaria, garantindo a conformidade com as apólices de seguro e liquidação junto às seguradoras.

Inteligência de Dados: Monitoramento de KPIs de segurança e criação de dashboards de sinistralidade para suporte à decisão.

Auditoria de Processos: Verificação da performance de GRs e garantia de aderência total ao Plano de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR).

Mediação de Conflitos: Alinhamento operacional entre a operação (ponta) e a estratégia (seguradora/cliente).

Treinamento e Capacitação: Desenvolvimento de programas de treinamento para transportadoras e motoristas sobre normas de segurança e protocolos de contingência.

Cultura de Prevenção: Promoção ativa de diretrizes de segurança e prevenção de riscos em toda a cadeia de transporte.

Requisitos e qualificações

Desenvolvimento de Dashboards Estratégicos: Criação e manutenção de painéis de indicadores (KPIs) para monitoramento em tempo real de sinistralidade, performance de Gerenciadoras de Riscos e eficiência de transportadoras.

Análise Preditiva de Sinistralidade: Extração e tratamento de bases de dados para identificação de padrões de roubos e avarias, permitindo a antecipação de zonas de risco e otimização das rotas logísticas.

Auditoria Digital (PGR): Utilização de análise de dados para auditar a aderência aos Planos de Gerenciamento de Riscos, cruzando informações de rastreamento com as normas estabelecidas em apólice.

Gestão de KPIs de Operação e Segurança: Monitoramento técnico de metas de segurança, traduzindo dados complexos em relatórios executivos para suporte à tomada de decisão junto a seguradoras e alta gestão.

Automação e Otimização de Processos: Implementação de fluxos de dados para agilizar a regulação de sinistros e a comunicação entre transportadoras e seguradoras, reduzindo o tempo de resposta e erros manuais.

Domínio de Excel (Power Query e Pivot) / Desenvolvimento de dashboards / Gestão e tratamento de Dados.

title: Especialista em Riscos - Prevenção a Fraude
description:
SOBRE A POSIÇÃO:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Especialista de Riscos , para atuar de forma estratégica e “hands-on” na prevenção e detecção de fraudes , com foco monitoramento e análise preditiva de dados e tendências para detecção e mitigação do risco de fraude. Essa pessoa terá papel-chave na implementação de mecanismos de prevenção e detecção a fraudes no onboarding e transacional além da melhoria contínua de processos e automação de processos e poderá atuar como referência técnica ou liderança de projetos relacionados à eficiência e robustez da área de Prevenção a Fraude em ambiente financeiro/fintech.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Atuar na elaboração/calibração de regras de prevenção a fraude no processo e onboarding e transacional;
  • Implementar o monitoramento das transações, processos e comportamentos suspeitos, atípicos (outliers, desvios de comportamento, inconsistências);
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de prevenção a fraudes;
  • Participar no desenvolvimento e teste de regras, parâmetros e modelos de prevenção a fraude;
  • Elaborar políticas, procedimentos e manuais de prevenção e investigação a fraudes;
  • Realizar análises com alto nível de detalhamento, produzindo relatórios, indicadores e materiais executivos para comitês e stakeholders;
  • Interagir com áreas parceiras (Riscos, Jurídico, Produto, Operações, Tecnologia, Auditoria) e apoiar demandas internas e externas.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Graduação completa em: Administração, Contabilidade, Engenharia, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em Prevenção e Investigação a fraudes em instituições financeiras e/ou fintechs;
  • Conhecimento sobre produtos, tais como: contas de pagamentos, Baas;
  • Conhecimento sólido da regulamentação do Banco Central do Brasil aplicável ao tema;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento transacional e prevenção a fraudes;
  • Excelente atenção aos detalhes e análise de dados para execução e registro das análises e pareceres;
  • ·Expertise em liderança de projetos e/ou atuação como referência técnica em projetos de automação e melhoria contínua.

SERÁ CONSIDERADO COMO UM DIFERENCIAL:

  • Experiência com estruturas de prevenção a fraudes (KPI’s / KRI’s);
  • Elaboração de reportes e apresentações executivas para auxiliar as decisões estratégicas com análise quantitativa.

title: Operador de Preparação II
description:
OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL DO CARGO

Fabricar Semi-Acabado no setor de fabricação, atendendo a programação de produção seguindo padrões de Boas Práticas de Fabricação, Segurança e Qualidade.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES / ATIVIDADES

  • Realizar as atividades relacionadas aos processos de fabricação de Coloração Creme na plataforma Becomix, Água Oxigenada, Condicionador na planta Solo, Hidratante Corporal, Shampoo, Condicionador, Gel Capilar, Sabonete Liquido, Creme de Pentear, Creme de Tratamento, Bálsamo Pós Barba, Desodorante Roll-on, Protetor Solar, Creme de Barbear, Óleo Paixão, Óleo Bronzeador, Enxaguatório Bucal, Gel e Creme Dental, Desodorante Aerosol, Espuma de Barbear em Aerosol, Loção Pós Barba, Removedor de Esmalte, bem como os processos de operação nível I.
  • Cumprir as normas da empresa de segurança individual e coletiva, meio ambiente, qualidade, Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e código de ética. Zelar pelo patrimônio da empresa.
  • Receber as matérias-primas fracionadas pela área de Pesagem e posicioná-las nas plataformas de preparação.
  • Movimentar as matérias-primas nas plataformas de preparação.
  • Conferência de matérias-primas antes do inicio da manipulação.
  • Realizar fracionamento de matérias-primas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar o preenchimento das documentações definidas pelos procedimentos (como Ordens de Produção e checklists e etiquetas de identificação dos semi-acabados).
  • Manipular os produtos nos tempos pré-definidos, com qualidade e segurança, seguindo as orientações do método de fabricação (Folha de Processo). Minimizar perdas. Manter limpo e organizado o local de trabalho.
  • Coletar amostras de semi-acabado e enviar ao Controle de Qualidade para análises físico-químicas e microbiológicas.
  • Realizar transferência dos produtos aprovados para seus tanques de estocagem e posterior liberação destes para as linhas de envase.
  • Realizar a limpeza, organização, sanitização e conservação dos reatores de preparação e tanques de estocagem, bem como os equipamentos auxiliares (empilhadeiras manuais, bombas de transferência, tubulações, mangotes, engates rápidos, paleteiras elétrica).
  • Reportar ao superior imediato sempre que houver dúvidas, sugestões ou problemas relacionados às operações e às atividades afins.
  • Acompanhar a programação dos reatores.
  • Auxiliar o Operador de Preparação III na fabricação de produtos, quando necessário.

title: Analista Sr. de Analytics e Estratégia de Investimentos
description:

title: Engenheiro de rede sênior
description:
Responsável por projetar, implementar e manter a infraestrutura crítica de redes que suporta um ecossistema multi-cloud e multicanal. O desafio envolve gerenciar conectividade de alta disponibilidade para transações financeiras e de loteria, integrando redes móveis, ambientes de Contact Center (CCX/CCaaS) e roteamento complexo entre data centers físicos e provedores de nuvem, garantindo segurança e desempenho de ponta a ponta.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Roteamento e Core Switching: Gerenciar protocolos de roteamento dinâmico, com foco obrigatório em BGP para interconexão de sistemas autônomos e tráfego multi-homed.

• Conectividade Híbrida e Cloud: Implementar e gerenciar roteamento em ambientes de nuvem (AWS Transit Gateway, Azure Virtual WAN), garantindo comunicação fluida entre ambientes on-premises e instâncias em nuvem.

• Segurança de Perímetro e VPN: Configurar e manter túneis VPN (Site-to-Site e Client-to-Site) e infraestrutura de Firewall, com domínio em tecnologias Cisco e/ou Fortinet.

• Infraestrutura de Voz e Contact Center: Sustentar e otimizar ambientes Cisco Unified Contact Center Express (CCX) e integração com soluções CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service), garantindo Qualidade de Serviço (QoS) de voz.

• Mobilidade e Redes Sem Fio: Projetar e gerenciar redes Wi-Fi corporativas de alta densidade e configurar integração com redes móveis (4G/5G) para redundância de terminais de loteria e POS.

• Monitoramento e Performance: Utilizar ferramentas e protocolos de análise de tráfego (Wireshark, SNMP) para troubleshooting avançado e otimização de latência em transações críticas.

• Suporte a Projetos Multicanais: Garantir que a rede suporte a jornada do cliente em todos os canais (Físico, Web e App), mantendo segmentação de rede e segurança de dados em conformidade com PCI-DSS e LGPD/GDPR.

• Qualidade e Governança: Atuar em conformidade com diretrizes ISO 9001, ISO 27001, políticas de Jogo Responsável e garantir a confidencialidade das informações da organização

title: Senior Software Engineer - Game Technology
description:
We're looking for a hardworking and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join Wildlife's Live Games Tech Team in São Paulo.

At Wildlife, senior engineers don't just execute - they own. Our Live Games Tech Team operates with end-to-end accountability across some of our most-played titles, with millions of daily active players worldwide. You'll make architectural decisions, lead technical initiatives, define how the team operates in production, and mentor the engineers around you - all without layers of approval slowing you down. The scope is large. The autonomy is real. And the scale means your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on a product that millions of people play every day.

Our stack spans Unity/C# on the client, Go on the backend, and AWS with Kubernetes for infrastructure.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex features across mobile client and backend services, making sound architectural trade-offs.
  • Own technical decisions for your area - architecture, performance, scalability, long-term maintainability - and be accountable for the outcomes.
  • Ship new versions to production and take full ownership of post-release behavior: monitoring, reading signals, and iterating fast.
  • Define and evolve the team's observability practices: SLIs, alerting, dashboards, and incident response processes.
  • Proactively identify and drive improvements across the codebase: performance, scalability, and engineering quality.
  • Mentor and coach more junior engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and pair programming.
  • Shape the technical direction of features in collaboration with product and design from their earliest stages.
  • Translate technical complexity into clear, timely communication for the team and stakeholders.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Solid experience as a software developer, with production systems at scale.
  • Strong background in software architecture and system design for production environments.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident response in live systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers.
  • Working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Unity/C# for mobile development.
  • Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems.
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure.
  • Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products.

MORE ABOUT YOU

You've shipped things that live in production, and you understand what real ownership means. You make architectural decisions with confidence - and you can explain the 'why' to engineers, product, and leadership without losing the room. You raise the technical bar for the people around you, not as overhead, but as a natural consequence of how you work. You think in systems. You don't wait for the perfect spec. And when something breaks in production, you're the one people want to have already been thinking about it.

ABOUT WILDLIFE

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create and maintain games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.
